QUOTE: The one exception is three server errors: `DELETED_ROOT_POST_ERROR`, `TOWN_SQUARE_READ_ONLY_ERROR` and `PLUGIN_DISMISSED_POST_ERROR`. For those, `removePost` deletes the local post (lines 176–181). Any other failure leaves the post in place.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names all three server errors (deleted root post, read-only town square, plugin-dismissed post) that cause the failed post to be removed rather than kept.
